answer_2.quote: We compare the likelihoods of sentences under two generative models (Figure ). The bag model makes the assumption that every sentence is drawn independently from the main theme of the story (represented by E). On the other hand, the chain model assumes that a story begins with a (i) bag (ii) chain theme, and sentences linearly follow each other. . ∆ l is computed as the difference in negative loglikelihoods between the bag and chain models
automatic_metrics: ∆l (difference in negative log-likelihoods between bag and chain models)

answer_4.quote: We collect first-person perspective stories in three stages on Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk), using a pairing mechanism to account for topical variation between imagined and recalled stories.
answer_4.guideline: Workers also write a 2-3 sentence summary to be used in subsequent stages, and indicate how long ago the events took place (in weeks or months; TIMESINCEEVENT).
